## Activity

During June 2025, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 420 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The service should continue to maintain complete and accurate records of captures, including any issues that may affect processing or assessment.

## Image quality

There were 19 ungradable captures during the reporting period. The ungradable rate was 4.5 per cent. Recurring camera issues should be recorded with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process. Clear documentation of equipment problems will assist with monitoring image quality and identifying any ongoing operational concerns.

## Grading

A total of 106 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. This measure should continue to be monitored alongside activity and image quality, particularly where equipment issues may affect the time required to complete grading. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk.
